name: remote-mode-switch-clears-every-turn
description: A remote session is working and focused when the person switches to built-in mode. Every remote turn and the focus are cleared, so the status goes idle, and hook events heard after the switch are ignored.
reason: Remote turns describe sessions PowerUp no longer drives once it is in built-in mode. Leaving them in place would keep the light amber for a session the person has stopped controlling.
source: DESIGN.md v1.10 'clearRemoteTurns() … every control-mode switch'; DESIGN.md v2.2 B 'Focus clears on control-mode switch'; AppState.syncControlMode, AppState.handleRemoteEvent (remote mode only)

script.reason: Built-in mode ignores hook events, even a heartbeat that would otherwise start a turn.

transcript.text: Focus → alpha — only this session is spoken now.
Built-in session mode — PowerUp runs its own Claude session again.
